title: 2024-06-12 Content action taken over the creator incident

meta.Event: Content action taken over the creator incident
meta.Subject: Colorful_Palette

source:
The operation team (Colorful Palette and SEGA) acted on the incident involving a song provider: deleting in-game song data and audio, unlisting related songs and MVs on the official channel, taking down 'SEKAI' versions from music platforms, and apologising to players in the notice.

(Source: operation team notices, June 2024)
